Round 100: your notes on round 98, with the titles

No mask in front of him anywhere. A24 redone as a flat design (two ways to draw the snake). S15's lens and orbs, T41's egg, A22's orbs fixed. A34 and the A10 hero dropped; two new hero directions. Each slot three ways: no words, a small title, and Steam's standard (shown again at the sizes Steam shrinks it to). This page replaces round 99, which was too heavy to open; its title manner is the same (Phylactery Serif in cream, the It Follows cover's way). T01's icons and event cover are unchanged from round 98.
